cds.title: University of Tennessee, Knoxville Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF, Institutional Research and Strategic Analysis)

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs from the Common Data Set G1 for the full 2026-2027 academic year: in-state tuition $11,560, out-of-state and nonresident tuition $31,672, required fees $2,464, on-campus food and housing $14,738 (housing $9,572 + food $5,166). Estimated expenses (residents): books and supplies $1,598, transportation $3,500, other $3,042 (other costs shown = transportation + other). H6: institutional need-based and non-need-based aid are both ticked as available to degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates; 86 received it, average $9,570 (total $822,998), and the CDS does not split need from non-need aid.

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (Fall 2025 entering class): 53,841 applied, 23,464 admitted (43.6%), 7,143 enrolled. Residency rows: in-state 11,980 applied / 8,725 admitted / 4,326 enrolled, out-of-state 41,408 / 14,526 / 2,764, international 452 / 213 / 53; the admitted and enrolled rows add up to the totals, but the applied rows add up to 53,840 against a printed total of 53,841 (one student off in the CDS). Waiting list: the CDS prints 11,980 as the number offered a place, which equals the in-state applicant count and looks like a copy error, so it is left empty; 3,516 accepted and 134 were admitted. No early decision; nonbinding early action (counts not reported). Undergraduate enrollment (32,041) and the nonresident count (312) are the 'Total Undergraduates' figures; degree-seeking only: 31,923 and 293. The GPA breakdown is the 'all enrolled students' column; the average of 4.25 is the only GPA figure printed under C12 (the share reporting a GPA is not readable), so the share is left empty. UT required test scores, so nearly all enrolled students submitted them; the percentiles cover those who did.
